english_source_note: Estimates for the Sum of Prime Reciprocals
statement_en: There exists a constant $B$ (now called the Mertens constant) such that $$\sum_{p\le x}\frac{1}{p}=\log\log(x)+B+O\left(\frac{1}{\log(x)}\right).$$
callout_body: 存在一个常数$B$(现在称之为Mertens常数)使得$$\sum_{p\le x}\frac{1}{p}=\log\log(x)+B+O\left(\frac{1}{\log(x)}\right)$$
